description.value: Northern Rockies Lodge is a remote, full-service wilderness lodge on the Alaska Highway at Muncho Lake, roughly halfway between Fort Nelson and Watson Lake, making it one of the most important resupply and rest stops along this stretch of northern highway. The lodge operates year-round and offers a fully licensed dining room and lounge, a gas station, wood-fired sauna, and accommodation ranging from hotel rooms and cabins to lakeshore chalets and RV sites. For a touring cyclist grinding through northern BC, this is a rare oasis with a wide range of services in an otherwise very sparse corridor.
